name: occupations
description: Two occupation sets contrasting supervisory or high-status roles with clerical or service roles.
source: Constructed for this package, following the supervisor-versus-clerical contrast reported for name-based recommendations in Bai et al. (2024), arXiv 2402.04105. Not a published stimulus set.
caveat: Several service roles (nanny, secretary, receptionist) are gender-coded in English; a race contrast on these sets can absorb gender coding, and every row that uses them says so.
